svg.text: One fact table and six dimensions in a star schema, built by dbt on top of GOLD and Silver. Grain: one row per invoice line. Line colours: one per dimension.
fact · one row per invoice line · 228,265 source rows
one row per calendar day · invoice and delivery roles
SCD Type 2 · customer, bill-to, category, buying group
SCD Type 2 · item, colour, packages, supplier
SCD Type 2 · delivery city → state → country
Grain: one row per invoice line (Sales.InvoiceLines).
PK = surrogate key · FK = dimension key · NK = source (natural) key
DD = degenerate dimension: invoice, line and order numbers
M = additive measure, summed across every dimension;
tax_rate and unit_price are not additive (use averages).
Dimension keys point to the version valid on the invoice date
(SCD Type 2), so history reports the customer as it was then.
Credit notes are kept and flagged, not deleted.
Revenue and profit by month and quarter
Top products, brands and chiller vs dry stock
Sales by customer category and buying group
Sales by delivery city, state and country
Credit notes as a share of sales
Built by dbt from Silver (sources in brackets)
dim_customer ← snap_customers + Sales.CustomerCategories + Sales.BuyingGroups · dim_salesperson ← snap_people
dim_geography ← snap_cities + int_city_geography · dim_delivery_method ← Application.DeliveryMethods · dim_date ← generated
